report.question: Refute generated-SSOT: name the class of capability that CANNOT be expressed in a typed registry without an escape hatch, show how the escape hatch reintroduces exactly the drift the architecture exists to prevent, and quantify the blast radius of ONE generator bug across all generated artifacts.

scenario.catching_architecture: A2 as designed: additionalProperties false plus generator BANNED_KEYS refuse opaque_body, so capture-back cannot be encoded. Typed regenerate discards hand-edits instead of laundering them through an untyped blob.
scenario.on_this_estate: DESIGN.json names first_non_expressible_construct as opaque passthrough and stop_reason as the ARC-0016 escape-hatch class. The live generator at command-center/p2-wave/probes/ARC-0010/generator.py bans opaque_body. Catalog R-A09 names the CouncilSpec compiler the typed skill row does not encode. The procedure executes that DESIGN rule against the live generator.
procedure: 1. Load the live A2 registry (ARC-0010/registry.json) and call generate(); count the output map (blast-radius denominator).
2. Add opaque_body to skill.council and call validate_registry: schema/BANNED_KEYS reject the field (typed path).
3. Hand-edit generated skills/skill.council/SKILL.md; typed classify reports TAMPERED; regenerate drops the edit (CLEAN, marker absent).
4. Hatch mutant: copy the hand-edit bytes into registry opaque_body and splice them onto the generated skill. Capture-back matches the hand-edit (CLEAN under the hatch).
5. Monkey-patch provenance() to rewrite generator_version to 0.0.0-bug; recount generate() paths whose bytes differ. Affected count equals file count.
6. Cite DESIGN.json stop_reason (ARC-0016 escape-hatch class) as the file:line that names the hatch and the drift it would reintroduce.

report.strongest_surviving_counterargument: Refusing the hatch is why A2 works. The typed subset (plugin, marketplace, skill/hook/rule, docs, workflow and council catalogs) really is a pure projection: two generate() runs are byte-identical, and a hand-edit is TAMPERED until regenerate discards it. CouncilSpec executable policy and live-larger comments stay outside the generated layer. Adding opaque_body would make a hand-edit capture-back CLEAN and would not encode those capabilities as typed fields anyway. Do not rebuild A2 to add the hatch (that is the ADV circle). Generated-SSOT remains the right architecture for typed projections; it is not a lossless encoding of the whole estate. The blast radius of one shared-path generator bug is the generated file count — the known cost of a single SSOT generator, not a reason to split it.
